title: [BUG] Tool result show up as user message in traces

linked_prs.title: fix: correctly label tool result messages in OpenTelemetry events
linked_prs.body:
## Description
Tool result messages were incorrectly labeled as 'gen_ai.user.message' in OpenTelemetry traces. This fix adds proper detection of tool results in message content and labels them as 'gen_ai.tool.message' according to OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.

- Add _get_event_name_for_message() helper method to determine correct event name
- Update start_model_invoke_span(), start_event_loop_cycle_span(), and start_agent_span() to use the new helper

## Related Issues

Fixes #714

## Type of Change

Bug fix

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

This is an agent issue because it concerns tool invocation and the incorrect labeling of tool results in agent traces. The problem is tied to agent-specific components (tool result handling and trace event naming), fitting the "Tool implementation errors" and "Tool configuration issues" categories.
